tagline.en: Skywork's next-generation interactive world model, tuned for long-horizon, streaming scenes.
tagline.zh: Skywork 新一代交互式世界模型，面向长时程、流式场景。

en: Matrix-Game 3.0 is the next step in Skywork AI's interactive world-model family, released with open code and weights. Like its predecessor it generates game-style video that responds to actions, with an emphasis on longer-horizon, streaming scenes.

It runs image-conditioned: you give it a starting image and control actions such as moving forward or turning the camera, and it synthesizes the scene from there. The runtime is vendored in-tree in WorldFoundry, including an efficient light VAE path, so no external Matrix-Game checkout is needed at run time — only the checkpoint assets.
In WorldFoundry you launch the cityscape image route, provide an image and actions, and it produces the interactive video.
zh: Matrix-Game 3.0 是 Skywork AI 交互式世界模型家族的下一步，开放代码与权重。与上一代一样，它生成随动作响应的游戏风格视频，并更强调长时程、流式的场景。
它以图像为条件运行：你给它一张起始图片和前进、转动镜头等控制动作，它就从此处合成场景。其运行时已内置于 WorldFoundry（包含高效的 light VAE 路径），运行时无需外部 Matrix-Game 代码库，只需 checkpoint 资产。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你启动 cityscape image 路径，给它一张图片与动作序列，它就会生成这段可交互视频。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when you want an openly-licensed interactive world model geared toward longer, streaming rollouts driven by camera and movement actions from an initial image.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可、面向更长时程流式生成、由镜头与移动动作从初始图片驱动的交互式世界模型时，选择它。

notFor.en: Not for offline text-to-video or long non-interactive films; it is built for action-driven interactive scenes. Checkpoint weights are external assets you supply separately.
notFor.zh: 不适合离线文生视频或长篇非交互影片；它面向动作驱动的交互式场景。Checkpoint 权重为外部资产，需另行提供。

en: Interactive world model focused on long-horizon streaming scenes
Image-conditioned with camera and movement actions
In-tree runtime with an efficient light VAE path
zh: 面向长时程流式场景的交互式世界模型
以图像为条件，支持镜头与移动动作
内置运行时，含高效 light VAE 路径
